subject.title: fix(media): make wake-false direct fallback reason-aware

question: Is the skipped Mantis internal-path artifact enough proof for this generated-media wake-false fix, or should merge wait for visible Telegram Desktop or equivalent live delivery proof from the proof stack?
rationale: ClawSweeper's real-behavior proof gate is not satisfied by an artifact where both baseline and candidate are skipped, but maintainers may choose to accept scheduler-boundary proof for an internal path that normal Telegram Desktop cannot expose.

options.title: Require stacked live proof
options.body: Keep this PR open until the proof harness or proof stack shows baseline missing/blocking the generated media and candidate delivering exactly one visible image or equivalent redacted live evidence.

options.title: Accept internal-path proof
options.body: Allow maintainers to override the proof gate based on the focused scheduler tests and Mantis fixed=true artifact, while recording that no visible Telegram delta was observed.

options.title: Pause until harness lands
options.body: Wait for the separate proof-harness PR to land or become usable before re-reviewing this production fix.

recommendation.title: Require stacked live proof
